logicGrid.title: The Campus Research Consortium
logicGrid.description: Four engineering students each lead a research lab, specialize in one technology domain, and use a distinct primary language. Deduce who works where!
clues: The engineer working in the Bhabha Core writes their core algorithms in Go.
Kabir is researching Quantum Comp, but does not work in the Turing Lab.
The researcher coding in C++ is based at Turing Lab.
Diya works directly in the Tesla Center and collaborates with the AI Systems team.
The Quantum Comp specialist prefers Python for rapid prototyping.

verseOfTheDay.sanskrit:
यस्मान्नोद्विजते लोको लोकान्नोद्विजते च यः।
हर्षामर्षभयोद्वेगैर्मुremote क्तो यः स च मे प्रियः॥
verseOfTheDay.transliteration:
yasmān nodvijate loko lokān nodvijate ca yaḥ |
harṣāmarṣa-bhayodvegair mukto yaḥ sa ca me priyaḥ ||
verseOfTheDay.english: He by whom no one is agitated and who is not agitated by the world, who is freed from excessive delight, envy, fear, and anxiety—he is dear to Me.

thoughtOfTheDay.title: Chitta Vritti Nirodha (Calming the Mental Whirlpools)
thoughtOfTheDay.quote: योगश्चित्तवृत्तिनिरोधः — Yoga is the stilling of the fluctuations of consciousness.
thoughtOfTheDay.reflection: Your smartphone feeds your mind micro-waves of reactive outrage and novelty. Today, remember that focus is not the absence of thought, but the conscious choice of which single thought receives your energy. Practice single-tasking for the next 4 hours.

dailyMantra.name: Om Namah Shivaya (Panchakshari Mantra)
dailyMantra.meaning: I bow to Shiva—the purest inner Consciousness that resides peacefully in the silence beyond thoughts.
dailyMantra.benefit: Directly harmonizes the five elements within the body and steadies the nervous system.
